scaleBeatText: A sequence of foods on the table. Eat them in the right order.

👑 Speakers from Stonebridge, Thornfield, Ashford ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
A ship the size of weather settles over the haven. Out steps something with too many limbs and impeccable manners. The table is set. The cameras are everywhere.
The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.
◈ OVERTIME ×1 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+25% HP, +12% damage). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −4. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock.
◈ OVERTIME ×2 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+50% HP, +24% damage, +1 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −14. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock.
◈ OVERTIME ×3 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+75% HP, +36% damage, +1 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −18. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock.

◈ SYSTEM: "33. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,330 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."
🗣️ Betty to Teresa, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"
◈ OVERTIME ×4 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+100% HP, +48% damage, +2 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −22. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock.
◈ OVERTIME ×5 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+125% HP, +60% damage, +2 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −29. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock.
